_comment: Edits from loose-realism-v1.json NOT in the proven pack, with the reason. 'unread'/'unlocated' are held, not condemned - re-check after the liveness map improves.

edits.why: trapLoss=true is the master enable for heavy-touch ('loss') outcomes; trapLossDashOnly restricts them to sprint traps. Clearing the restriction lets walking/running traps also get away from the player — the most direct '

Reach-out trap: the player stretches to a ball that is not quite at the feet (enabled, up to reachOut.ballSpeed 50 kph). Reducing reach by 15% lets slightly off-line passes and deflections slip past instead of being hook

At PA3 a through ball is redirected to a runner from any angle (180). Narrowing to 120 means badly aimed through balls are no longer fully corrected and run through to nobody / the keeper — the classic 'wayward through b
PA2 equivalent: retarget cone shrinks ~27% so the stick must point closer to the runner. Keeps ordering PA1 (15) < PA2 (22) < PA3 (120).

Crosses at PA3 are currently aimed at a box target regardless of stick direction. 120 leaves a wide cone but lets a cross aimed well away from any teammate go where it was aimed. adjustSearchAngleRate/adjustStartPointRat

passget.defence maps a defensive attribute (paraMin 60 .. paraMax 90) to a timing 'sec' that is currently flat (0.4/0.4). Pattern-matching trap.reactionTrapBall.*.reactionTime suggests it is the defender's reaction delay

Same lever for the finesse/control shot (+17%, matching the normal-shot ratio so the two types keep their relative feel). Control shots are the current meta for guaranteed corners-of-the-net placement; a higher ceiling m

Chip-shot launch elevation in degrees. +4 deg makes chips hang higher and longer, giving the keeper more time to recover and sending over-hit chips over the bar, without changing the 40-80 kph speed window.
